children.game_version: A 'Follow the Leader' game where the leader chooses different directions to 'hitchhike' towards.

avoid: Backward steps that might cause loss of balance
seniors.seated_version: Perform the thumb waves and claps while seated, focusing on arm extension and gentle shoulder movement instead of a full shimmy.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the arm movements while standing still or holding onto a chair for balance, omitting the steps back or sideways.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce the speed of the thumb waves; keep the arm movements within a comfortable range of motion for the shoulder.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Thumb extended (hitchhiking gesture), waving over the shoulder; hand claps
movement_profile.footwork: Steps back or sideways (optional, depends on the variant)
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Stationary or moving laterally/backward in a social dance floor setting
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Shimmy body ripples and lateral hip movements
movement_profile.posture: Upright but relaxed, allowing for torso ripples

signature_moves.description: Waving the extended thumb over the shoulder three times
signature_moves.name: The Thumb Wave

signature_moves.description: A single rhythmic clap following the three thumb waves
signature_moves.name: The Motown Clap

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Stiffness in the torso; the shimmy should be fluid

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Three pulses followed by a sharp accent (clap)
music_profile.sound_description: Characterized by the driving 'Motown beat' with a prominent snare on the backbeat and melodic, walking basslines that support the rhythmic thumb-waving.

basic_steps: Extend right thumb and wave it over the right shoulder three times
Extend left thumb and wave it over the left shoulder three times
Incorporate a shimmy (torso ripple) throughout the arm movements
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 time, with movements corresponding to three beats and a clap on the fourth
